properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued November 15 at 4:22PM CST until November 15 at 4:45PM CST by NWS Brownsville TX
properties.description:
SMWBRO

The National Weather Service in Brownsville has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Baffin Bay to Port Mansfield TX out 20 NM...

* Until 445 PM CST.

* At 421 PM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located 13 nm north of Laguna Madre, moving
southeast at 5 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts to 40 knots.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* The severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 15 at 4:40AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
properties.description:
Confidence is growing in the potential for a strong coastal storm
to take a more northerly track through the Bering Sea mid-week.
Depending on the final track of the system, minor to moderate
coastal flooding impacts may be a possible for parts of the West
Coast, with sea level rises between 3 to 7 ft possible. In
addition to the coastal impact potential, periods of moderate to
heavy snow and strong winds could begin as early as Tuesday night
and last into Friday. The combination of winds and heavy snow
could lead to reduced visibilities at times. We will continue to
monitor this system closely and provide updates as additional
information becomes available.

build across Hawaiian waters and peak later today and Monday as
the period shortens to 12 seconds. The swell will produce
moderate to heavy surges in north-facing harbors, especially at
Kahului and Hilo Harbors. Mariners using these harbors should
exercise caution when mooring or launching vessels and when
entering or leaving port. The swell will diminish Tuesday.

properties.areaDesc: Kenedy Island; Willacy Island; Cameron Island
properties.headline: Rip Current Statement issued November 15 at 2:27AM CST until November 17 at 6:00AM CST by NWS Brownsville TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding
expected. For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of
3 to 8 feet expected in the surf zone. For the High Rip
Current Risk, dangerous rip currents expected.

* WHERE...Kenedy Island, Willacy Island and Cameron Island
Counties.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 6 PM this evening
to 6 AM CST Tuesday. For the High Rip Current Risk, from this
evening through late Monday night.

* IMPACTS...Nuisance flooding is expected, with water reaching
or pushing into the dunes on South Padre Island. Vehicles,
except those with four wheel drive and high wheel bases, will
be unable to be driven on the beach. This includes locations
north of Public Beach Access #3. Minor to moderate beach
erosion is expected. Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions
and localized beach erosion. Rip currents can sweep even the
best swimmers away from shore into deeper water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Max inundation is expected near high tide
at 1115 PM tonight and again at 1122 PM Monday night.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.
